verdict.rationale: Smithery is an MCP registry, hosting and connection platform, so usage analytics is a fair axis, but nothing in the evidence documents dashboards or metrics for call volumes, users, errors or cost. The October 2026 shutdown of the hosted connection services also leaves only a public registry and CLI.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see usage analytics for the servers and tools my org consumes or publishes — call volumes, users, errors, and cost
